title: Triangle-Anchor Quantum Memory & Synchronous Mesh: Topological Phase-Locking, Coherent Excitation Trapping, and Autonomous Memory Persistence on IBM Heron Heavy-Hex Qubits
description: Preregistered experimental data, circuits, and findings verifying topological phase-locking, coherent excitation trapping (Z = 13.63), inter-cell quantum conduction, and autonomous pump-and-decouple quantum DRAM retention (+15.62% advantage over idle transmon decay) on utility-scale superconducting quantum processors (IBM Heron r2 ibm_marrakesh and ibm_kingston).
